headline: Public hearing on a second accessory dwelling unit at 88 Tsienneto Rd, and a rehearing request for a recovery residence at 32 Crystal Ave.
summary: A public hearing covers a variance request to allow a second accessory dwelling unit at 88 Tsienneto Rd. A rehearing request asks for another review of a denied variance for a men's recovery residence at 32 Crystal Ave.
items: Rehearing request in case 26-127 (tabled from 10/15/26) for a 10-bed, Level III men's group recovery residence at 32 Crystal Ave
Public hearing on case 26-133 at 88 Tsienneto Rd: variance to allow a second accessory dwelling unit (ADU) in a proposed addition, where only one is permitted

ZONING BOARD OF ADJUSTMENT – AGENDA 
November 5, 2026 
 
LIVE  
 
Zoom Link 
URL: https://zoom.us/j/323909140    
Enter Meeting ID: 323909140 
 
 
ADMINISTRATIVE BUSINESS: 
 
26-127 (Tabled from 10/15/26) 
REQUEST FOR REHEARING 
Applicant: Revive Recovery Resource Center; Jessica Carter 
Owner: Dovaro Trust, Palmisano Robert J. Trustee 
Parcel ID 32020 
  32 Crystal Ave 
Zoned:  GC 
 
The applicant is requesting a rehearing of case 26-127 denying a variance to the terms of Article VI, 
Section 165-3.1.A of the Town of Derry Zoning Ordinance to permit the operation of a 10-bed, Level III 
Men’s group recovery residence within the existing structure on the property.  
 
 
PUBLIC HEARING: 
 
26-133 
Applicant: Dennis Labrie 
Owner: Greenfield Revocable Trust, Thomas J Greenfield Trustee 
Parcel ID 08042-002 
  88 Tsienneto Rd 
Zoned:  LDR 
 
The applicant is requesting a variance to the terms of Article III, Section 165-25 of the Town of Derry 
Zoning Ordinance to allow a second Accessing Dwelling Unit (ADU) on the property located within a 
proposed addition where only one ADU is permitted. 
 
 
OTHER BUSINESS 
 
CORRESPONDENCE   
 
APPROV AL OF MINUTES  9/17/26, 10/15/26 
 
ADJOURN
